requestPolicy: Original once-per-second two-route loop; first transport failure skips remaining route as before. No extra requests.

sourceInputs.cache: Base64 original bytes read from existing loopback cache before parsing, original byte SHA256, route and request/read clocks; oversized reads explicitly truncated and fatal.
sourceInputs.sig: Original raw line SHA256 including newline, segment identity/path, byte offset/length, original sequence/hash/previous, start bookmark. Raw source separately retained.
sourceInputs.mapping: Original effective-universe file reference; actual effective cache mappings witnessed only in original response bodies.

consumption: Every actual sampler invocation has begin with exact supplied now and input reference, followed by completion with emission ordinal range. No-sample invocations and failed polls remain recorded.
firstAvailability: Actual recorded observer argument, not inferred from an earlier stored source row or collector publication.
rotation: Each observed transition has old/new bookmark. No global chain or completeness across independently rotated segments is asserted.
termination: Create-new terminal seal pins gzip bytes/SHA, trace chain head, output count, final bookmark, mapping/producer. Missing or incomplete seal cannot support full verification.
selection: Original book/trade policy unchanged; new trace I/O overhead is a separately declared producer/capture condition. No active or historical cohort is relabeled.
authority: Read-only observation evidence, never financial authority, settlement equivalence or calibrated profit.
